name: houston_outage_resilience_revised_comparison

architecture.parameter_matching_target: spatial_residual at the locked 7-station, 5-pollutant, 48-hour output shape
architecture.parameter_matching_tolerance: within 1 percent for GRIN, IGNNK-style, multi-station TCN, DCRNN, and Graph WaveNet widths listed above

multi_station_group_rule: Three prespecified connected geographic triangles from the frozen coordinate graph; collectively cover all seven stations. The groups are locked before Houston 2025 is downloaded.

natural_comissingness.origin: event-aligned last missing hour before at least one core reading resumes
natural_comissingness.network_availability: at least one other station has a core reading at the origin
natural_comissingness.per_pollutant_analysis: Repeat event-aligned 6-hour and 24-hour gap counts and metrics separately for every station-pollutant channel, requiring another station to observe the same pollutant at the origin.
natural_comissingness.interpretation: secondary observable co-missingness and channel-gap case analyses; do not assert verified hardware or communications failure

calibration.strata: condition family by reported horizon by pollutant, pooling prespecified affected stations within each condition family
calibration.procedure: NLL scale with empirical shrinkage to pollutant-wide fallback, followed by finite-sample central-80 absolute standardized-residual conformal scale

statistics.pairing: same forecast origin, horizon, station, pollutant, condition, and seed
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction over all candidate-versus-comparator primary tests

grin_impute_tcn.label: GRIN independent reimplementation
grin_impute_tcn.paper: Filling the G_ap_s: Multivariate Time Series Imputation by Graph Neural Networks
grin_impute_tcn.code_policy: written independently from the paper description because the inspected reference repository did not contain a license file

ignnk_style_impute_tcn.label: IGNNK-style downstream comparator, not a claim of exact reproduction
ignnk_style_impute_tcn.paper: Inductive Graph Neural Networks for Spatiotemporal Kriging
ignnk_style_impute_tcn.difference: three-layer residual diffusion-GCN imputer is trained jointly with the probabilistic forecasting objective

reporting.undercoverage_rule: Report PICP80 and interval score for every outage duration and explicitly identify any 24-hour undercoverage.
reporting.natural_case_scarcity_rule: Report counts and state when natural co-missingness cases are too sparse for inference.
reporting.holdout_rule: Do not download or parse Houston 2025 until smoke/full development runs, refinement controls, calibration, statistics, and reporting code are verified and frozen.
